svg.title: User and server-session authentication - actual classes

g.text: User and server-session authentication - actual classes
Authentication and user administration have separate contracts.
Profile is optional in the database (0..1).
createUser creates both; authenticate requires a profile.
Manager-only list/create/updateProfile; first/last name are required by the API for new accounts and updates,
but V15 columns stay nullable for legacy rows. phoneNumber is optional (max 20).
Incomplete session identities return 401; disallowed roles return 403.
